title: The Real Reason Sam Altman Fired His Board
angle: The OpenAI board didn't fire Altman over safety concerns — they fired him because they discovered he was secretly negotiating a multi-billion dollar deal that would have made him the controlling shareholder, cutting them out entirely.

scenes.scene_name: The Hook — The Lie You Were Told
scenes.voiceover: Everyone said it was about AI safety. That was a lie. Here is what actually happened.
scenes.visual_description: Black screen. Bold white text slams in: 'YOU WERE LIED TO.' Camera shakes. Red tint floods frame.
scenes.caption_overlay: The real reason Sam Altman was fired...

scenes.scene_name: The Setup — Who Had the Power
scenes.voiceover: OpenAI's board had one job: stop anyone from controlling the most powerful AI company on Earth.
scenes.visual_description: Fast cuts: OpenAI HQ, board meeting silhouettes, org chart graphic zooming into Altman's name at center.
scenes.caption_overlay: The board existed for ONE reason...

scenes.scene_name: The Secret Deal — The Real Trigger
scenes.voiceover: Altman was quietly engineering a restructure that would give him equity — something he was explicitly forbidden from having.
scenes.visual_description: Documents flash on screen, redacted blocks, dollar signs, text zooms: 'EQUITY. CONTROL. FORBIDDEN.' Split screen of Altman smiling vs board members stone-faced.
scenes.caption_overlay: He was forbidden from owning equity. He tried anyway.

scenes.scene_name: The Firing — 4 Days That Broke Silicon Valley
scenes.voiceover: Friday night: fired. Saturday: chaos. Sunday: Microsoft bids $1B to hire the entire team. Monday: board collapses.
scenes.visual_description: Rapid-fire timeline graphics, Twitter notifications exploding, stock ticker crashing, Microsoft logo drops in like a bomb.

scenes.voiceover: Altman came back with MORE power. The board was dissolved. He got the restructure he wanted all along.
scenes.visual_description: Kognai faces camera, slow zoom in, eyebrows raised, then smirks. Text explodes: 'HE WON.' Golden confetti effect.
scenes.caption_overlay: He lost his job. He got everything he wanted.

scenes.scene_name: The Loop — The Lie Still Stands
scenes.voiceover: They still call it a safety dispute. Now you know the truth. Share this before it gets buried.
scenes.visual_description: Screen goes black. White text returns: 'EVERYONE SAID IT WAS ABOUT SAFETY.' Pause. Then: 'It never was.' Loops to opening frame.
scenes.caption_overlay: Save this. They don't want you to know.

hook_test.viral_proof: Videos using 'The real reason...' conspiracy-adjacent reveal format consistently hit 10M+ views. Examples: 'The Real Reason McDonald's Ice Cream Machines Are Always Broken' (14M+ TikTok), 'The Real Reason Johnny Depp Lost' (22M+ TikTok). The Altman firing generated 2B+ media impressions, making it a proven high-interest topic with built-in audience hunger for the hidden narrative.
hook_test.why_it_works: Viewers already have a surface-level understanding of the Altman firing, creating the perfect gap for a 'hidden truth' reveal. The format exploits cognitive dissonance — people were told one story, now they get the 'real' one. Conspiracy-adjacent framing without being false drives shares as viewers feel they are exposing others to suppressed information.
